verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, and both are broken the same way. Each crops the background to a blurry piece of the cross arm with a single metal hand, so the crucifix, which is the key image, is gone and the top third is dead dark space. 'Easter' is stretched almost edge to edge with almost no side margin, the thin frame line from the original is missing, and the text block sits low with no clear intent.
